searchText: Hey <@&1416139337179074590>. I'm a late comer for this years EPF and am only just getting around to working on a project. The [state growth spammer](https://github.com/ethpandaops/tooling-wishlist/blob/master/open-ideas/state-growth-spammer.md) sounds super interesting. To your knowledge is anyone working on this at the moment? Hey! Yeah <@703742742135570499> has worked on a few of those scenarios and we use them on perf-devnet-2 to bloat the state 🙂 I suggest to either look to: https://github.com/ethpandaops/spamoor/pull/72 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/2256 More updates in: https://cperezz.github.io/bloatnet-website/logbook.html
